name: aims_extract
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,os,re
os.makedirs('work/aims',exist_ok=True)
r=subprocess.run(['pdfinfo','sources/aims-math-07-04-337.pdf'],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/aims-math-07-04-337.pdf','work/aims.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True);print('txt',r.returncode,r.stderr)
r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-r','110','-png','sources/aims-math-07-04-337.pdf','work/aims/p'],capture_output=True,text=True);print('png',r.returncode,r.stderr)
t=open('work/aims.txt',encoding='utf-8').read()
print('LEN',len(t))
print(t[:3800])
for w in ['Conjecture','conjecture','Problem 6.3','tree','Tree','Corrig','double star']:
    print(w,[m.start() for m in re.finditer(w,t)][:40])
